summary: This page provides step-by-step Feed Roller instructions for the Vulcan OmniPro 220 welder, detailing how to check, remove, flip/replace, and reinstall the Feed Roller to match the wire type and size.
text_content:
12. Feed Roller Instructions:
Check that the Feed Roller is correct for the type of wire being used (solid core or flux-cored) and that it is turned to properly match the wire size marked on the Wire Spool:

a. Unscrew the Feed Roller Knob counterclockwise.

b. Remove the Feed Roller Knob to expose the Feed Roller.

c. Flip or replace the Feed Roller as needed and confirm that it is the correct Roller for the type of wire being used and that the number showing is the same as the wire diameter on the Spool.

d. Screw the Feed Roller Knob back into place to secure the Feed Roller.

Feed Roller Knob
Solid Core V-Groove
0.030/0.035 groove
0.025 groove
Feed Roller
0.045 groove
0.030/0.035 groove
Flux-Cored Knurled Groove

key_facts: Feed Roller must match the wire type: solid core (V-Groove) or flux-cored (Knurled Groove)
Feed Roller must be turned so the number showing matches the wire diameter on the Wire Spool
Solid Core V-Groove has groove sizes: 0.030/0.035 and 0.025
Flux-Cored Knurled Groove has groove sizes: 0.045 and 0.030/0.035
Feed Roller Knob is unscrewed counterclockwise to remove
Feed Roller can be flipped or replaced to select the correct groove size
Feed Roller Knob is screwed back in to secure the Feed Roller after adjustment
